historical_reference_dependency.effect_on_synq01_targets: SYNQ01 evidence can improve readiness but cannot close the B2 route. Until PREP02R obtains and qualifies a historical reference, or completes a documented failed acquisition effort sufficient for the stricter historical-uncertainty route, corrected-legacy admission must remain fail-closed for targets whose class contract requires that route.
historical_reference_dependency.no_substitution_rule: GNU B1 reproducibility and SYNQ01 synthetic oracles must not be substituted for independent B2 historical evidence.
